def nl(f,n,tries=6):
    best=(1,None)
    rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
    for _ in range(tries):
        try:
            r=least_squares(lambda p:f(p)-sigma,rng.normal(0,1,n)+0.5,max_nfev=300)
            b=np.var(r.fun)/v
            if b<best[0]: best=(b,r.x.round(4))
        except Exception as e: pass
    return best
